name: RetroArch (Gambatte)
location: RetroArch save folder (savefile_directory, sorted by core or content when enabled)
notes: Gambatte exposes the cartridge RAM as RETRO_MEMORY_SAVE_RAM (Cartridge::savedata_size, libgambatte/src/mem/cartridge_libretro.cpp), in 8 KiB banks: a 2 KiB RAM or an MBC2 gives 8 KiB, the RAM size code 5 gives 128 KiB. The clock is RETRO_MEMORY_RTC, a separate .rtc file.
